name: io.github.vitexsoftware/mcp-server-googleoffice
description: Google Workspace MCP server (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Tasks, Contacts, Chat).

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID of a Google Cloud 'Desktop app' or 'Web application' client

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret belonging to GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.name: USER_GOOGLE_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Default Google account e-mail used when a tool call does not name one

environmentVariables.name: WORKSPACE_MCP_CREDENTIALS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding the stored OAuth tokens (one JSON per account); use a per-user path

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_JSON
environmentVariables.description: Service-account key (JSON) for domain-wide delegation instead of OAuth user tokens

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a service-account key file for domain-wide delegation

environmentVariables.name: DWD_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated domains the service account may impersonate users in

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SINGLE_USER_MODE
environmentVariables.description: 1 = use any stored credentials from the credentials directory without session mapping (recommended under mcprack)

environmentVariables.name: WORKSPACE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Request only read-only scopes and expose only read-only tools

environmentVariables.name: WORKSPACE_MCP_PERMISSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Granular per-service permissions, e.g. 'gmail:organize drive:readonly' (exclusive with READ_ONLY/TOOLS)

environmentVariables.name: WORKSPACE_ATTACHMENT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where downloaded attachments are stored

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_PSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for Programmable Search Engine tools
